messages:
anya: Heads up — nightly backfill pushed a 3k-invoice batch and a bunch of them landed with invoice_num lower than existing ones in NetSuite. NS rejected ~120 invoices with duplicate/sequence errors.

finance-bot: ALERT: backfill-dlq: 120 items failed to apply to netsuite / reason: Invoice number conflict. see https://redwood.ops/alerts/2112349012

mike: Ugh. Which job variant ran? Was this the 'resync-all' or the new streaming backfill?

anya: It was the resync-all variant (cron-backfill v2) — we merged the sequencing change last week that assigns invoice_num based on incremental counter + timestamp suffix. Looks like race allowed older counters to replay.

jordan: Do we have a reproducible sequence? Any webhook retries from Stripe that might have re-ordered events? Can you paste a sample event id/log?

anya: Sample log snippet: ```INFO applying invoice 2026-03-22T03:04:12Z id=evt_3Kx... assigned_num=INV-10002 prev_high=INV-10120``` — so assigned_num < prev_high for many items. Webhook retries were also happening: stripe-delivery: 429/timeout spikes.

lev: Quick mitigation: we should pause resync-backfill job and run an idempotent resequencer that scans for invoice_num < max(account) and bumps them into the next available range, emitting mapping table to avoid dupes. I can run a safe dry-run first.

mike: +1 to pause. Also need a temporary fallback rule in the netsuite sync processor to auto-append a temp-suffix when NS returns duplicate error so we don't block downstream exports.

jordan: Action items: 1) @eng-sre pause cron-backfill (anya) 2) @lev run resequencer dry-run and post sample mappings here 3) @netsuite-admin manual apply for the 120 rejected records (we'll provide final mapping) 4) @mike prepare a postmortem note for finance ops (include cost/collection impact).

anya: On it — pausing now. Paused ID: cron-backfill/v2  (reason: invoice-seq-conflict).

lev: Dry-run complete. Output snippet: ```INV-10002 -> INV-10150 (candidate)``` — giving me a mapping for 120 entries. Will run idempotent apply at 12:30 UTC after sign-off.

netsuite-admin: I can take the mapped payloads and apply via CSV import. Please include original stripe_event_id to keep traceability. NetSuite will need a 15-min maintenance window.

mike: Please also capture which of these resulted from webhook retries vs backfill to avoid repeating this. Maybe add an opaque monotonic counter per-account instead of timestamp suffix.

anya: Noted. We'll add a guard: if assigned_num <= current_max then reassign using monotonic counter. I'll open a quick PR and include test for high-concurrency.

jordan: Thanks all. After netsuite-admin confirms import success, run the reconciler overnight and we'll close the incident. :thumbsup:

netsuite-admin: Import scheduled 12:40 UTC. Will update status here when complete.
